prompt: Name a Pink Floyd studio album.

answers.name: The Dark Side of the Moon
answers.fact: Spent over 900 weeks on the Billboard 200, longer than any other album.

answers.name: The Wall
answers.fact: Grew out of Roger Waters spitting at a fan during the 1977 tour and feeling appalled at himself.

answers.name: Wish You Were Here
answers.fact: Syd Barrett turned up at the sessions so changed that the band did not recognise him.

answers.name: Animals
answers.fact: The inflatable pig on the cover broke loose over Battersea and drifted into Heathrow's flight paths.

answers.name: The Division Bell
answers.fact: Much of it was cut on the Astoria, David Gilmour's converted houseboat on the Thames.

answers.name: The Piper at the Gates of Dawn
answers.fact: Written almost entirely by Syd Barrett; the title is a chapter of The Wind in the Willows.

answers.name: Meddle
answers.fact: Echoes fills the whole second side, opening with a piano note played through a Leslie speaker.

answers.name: A Momentary Lapse of Reason
answers.fact: Made after Waters left, while he was in court trying to stop the others using the name.

answers.name: The Final Cut
answers.fact: Subtitled a requiem for the post-war dream, and the last album Waters made with the band.

answers.name: Atom Heart Mother
answers.fact: The title suite runs 23 minutes with choir and brass. The sleeve is a photograph of a cow.

answers.name: The Endless River
answers.fact: Assembled in 2014 from Division Bell sessions as a farewell to Richard Wright.

answers.name: A Saucerful of Secrets
answers.fact: The only Pink Floyd album with both Syd Barrett and David Gilmour on it.

answers.name: Ummagumma
answers.fact: Half live, half studio, with a quarter of the studio disc handed to each member.

answers.name: Obscured by Clouds
answers.fact: A soundtrack for the French film La Vallée, recorded in two short bursts outside Paris.

answers.name: More
answers.fact: Their first soundtrack, for Barbet Schroeder's film about heroin on Ibiza.
